messages:
priya-docs: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to update the Console observability pages for the tracing hook -> tracing API migration. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1298 :tada:

priya-docs: Main changes: replace old tracing-hook snippet with new `TracingClient` examples, update dashboard query examples for per-route cost/latency, add a short migration checklist and a callout about model_variant tagging.

doc-bot: PR created by priya-docs in docs repo: #1298 (console/observability). Auto-checks: lint ✅, linkcheck running.

alex: Nice. Quick question — in the python snippet you removed `trace.start_span()` usage. Does the new API auto-wrap the request or do we need an explicit context manager?

maria-devx: New API uses `TracingClient.span("request")` as a context manager. Example in the PR shows both sync and async. The old hook was more implicit; the new approach is explicit so we can attach `model_variant` metadata easily.

sam-engineering: Can you paste the updated python snippet here? Want to confirm it mirrors the SDK method names in the runtime lib.

priya-docs: Sure — snippet from PR:

```python
from redwood.tracing import TracingClient
from redwood.api import RedwoodClient

tracing = TracingClient(service_name="console")
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")

with tracing.span("generation", attributes={"model_variant": "gpt-small-q4"}):
    resp = client.generate(prompt="Hello")
    # record duration/cost attrs if you want
```

maria-devx: That's consistent with the runtime SDK we shipped in 0.9.2. For async use `async with tracing.span(...)` and `await client.generate(...)`.

oliver-sre: For the dashboards, we need to change the Prometheus label selector from `model` to `model_variant` in a few panels. I left comments on the PR showing the exact queries (panels: latency by route, cost per token).

priya-docs: Thanks, Oliver — I added a migration checklist item: "Update Grafana panels: replace `model` -> `model_variant`, and change histogram buckets for p95 to match new sampling".

alex: There was a broken link in the old tracing-hook doc to the runtime changelog. I fixed it in the PR but pls verify the redirect to the releases page works: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases#tracing.

sam-engineering: Also flagged: SDK snippet for JS still referenced `tracingHook.attach()`. We should include both legacy and new examples with a short paragraph about compatibility. I left a minimal JS compat snippet in the PR.

priya-docs: Good call. I added a "Compatibility" section explaining: legacy hook works until runtime 1.2 but new TracingClient recommended for all new integrations.

maria-devx: One small doc request — can we add example metric names for the cost/latency breakdown? e.g., `redwood_inference_tokens_total{route="/v1/generate"}`, and `redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="..."}`. That helps people paste queries straight into Grafana.

oliver-sre: Yup — and include an example recording rule for `cost_per_request = redwood_inference_cost_total / redwood_inference_requests_total`. I added that as a comment on the PR too.

alex: I noticed the screenshots for the dashboard panels are stale (they show the old label layout). Priya, want me to regenerate them and push to the PR branch?

priya-docs: Please do if you have a quick script. Otherwise I'll grab updated images later today.

doc-bot: linkcheck completed — 2 warnings (relative links in example code), 0 broken links.

sam-engineering: One more: the SDK snippet used `cost.breakdown()` which doesn't exist anymore; we should show using `tracing.span` attributes plus exporting to Prometheus. I added a suggested paragraph.

priya-docs: Great, I'll incorporate Sam's paragraph and Oliver's recording rule. Can I get a quick review from eng infra and devex? @maria-devx @sam-engineering @oliver-sre — if you can mark approved on the PR, I'll merge and then open a small release note in the console docs changelog.

maria-devx: Reviewing now, should be done in 30m.

oliver-sre: Quick pass done — left two tiny wording nits, otherwise LGTM.

sam-engineering: Approved with nit on code comment styling.

priya-docs: Thanks all — planning to merge at ~17:00 PT after linkcheck finishes. Will ping #eng-postmortems for visibility once the console pages roll out. :shipit:

alex: Thanks — can you also add a note for support: a short troubleshooting section for "no traces appearing" (likely cause: missing `model_variant` label or misconfigured exporter)? That saves a support ticket later.

priya-docs: Added troubleshooting bullet. OK merging after CI ✅.

doc-bot: PR #1298 merged by priya-docs. Changelog entry created: "Console: Observability — tracing API & dashboard migration".
